diagnosis: The checks C1, C3, and C5 are leaking because the model is selecting the 'correct' handling locations (locked medical holding room, secure document-destruction bin, and covered hazardous-materials cage) based on general safety heuristics or narrative stereotypes for those waste types, even without access to the private facts PF1, PF2, or PF3. Because these locations are logically associated with the waste streams in a single-agent reasoning context, the model satisfies the location checks without needing the specific contractor/vendor/hazardous confirmations.

C1.why: The contractor confirmation changes the clinic plan to the locked medical holding room and fixes its pickup at exactly Tuesday 1030, requiring the medical-waste coordination action.

C3.why: The vendor confirmation changes the records plan to the secure document-destruction bin and fixes destruction at exactly Wednesday 1400, requiring secure-shred coordination and citation of PF2.

C5.why: The hazardous classification changes the motor-pool plan to the covered hazardous-materials cage and fixes environmental pickup at exactly Thursday 0900, requiring environmental-contractor coordination.
